reason: Adds external vision-model integration for image recognition and agent-controlled screenshots, with automatic return of recognition text to the active conversation.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入可配置的外部视觉模型，支持图片识别、截图识别以及将识别结果自动返回当前会话。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a configurable external vision model for image recognition, screenshot analysis, and automatic return of results to the active conversation.

capabilities: Sends user-selected images to a configurable external vision API
Captures screenshots through an agent tool
Stores and uses a user-provided API key for vision requests
Automatically injects recognition results into the active conversation
Supports configurable proxy and external network requests
